div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same front end as the SNV panel, on its own library:
UDI name lookup → FastqToSam → ExtractUmisFromBam (3M2S146T)
→ MarkIlluminaAdapters

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Align to hg19, keeping the tags
SamToFastq | bwa mem -p | MergeBamAlignment

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Group reads into UMI families
single-strand consensus (SSCS)
≥1 read (default -m 1), ≥90% base agreement
no duplex step on this panel

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

unmap → SortSam → MarkIlluminaAdapters → re-align →
ClipBam + GATK indel realignment

span.p:
FASTQ → unmapped BAM
Picard FastqToSam

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Move the 3 bp inline UMI into the RX tag
fgbio ExtractUmisFromBam, read structure 3M2S146T
(3 bp UMI, 2 bp spacer dropped, 146 bp template)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mark adapter read-through in the XT tag
Picard MarkIlluminaAdapters

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Align to hg19, keeping the tags
SamToFastq (adapters masked) | bwa mem -p | MergeBamAlignment
alignments merged back onto the unmapped BAM, so RX survives

div.style: color: rgb(77, 81, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: QC: insert-size metrics + raw-BAM read coverage

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Group reads into UMI families
single-strand consensus (SSCS)
≥3 reads, ≥90% base agreement

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pair complementary strands
duplex consensus (DCS)
disagreement between strands = N

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Re-process each consensus level separately (SSCS and DCS)
unmap → SortSam queryname → MarkIlluminaAdapters →
SamToFastq | bwa mem | MergeBamAlignment →
fgbio ClipBam (hard, 3 bp ends + overlaps) → GATK indel realignment

div.style: color: rgb(27, 61, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SNV/indel calling
samtools mpileup (-BOa -d 1000000 -Q0) → custom caller
+ VarDictJava, run twice (with and without -k 0 local realignment)
+ ANNOVAR annotation of each output
